signature: X_S <- A -> X_T or X_S -> A <- X_T
risk: common abstraction is not causal handoff

name: Moving-boundary overlap process

risk: graduality can be smuggled as continuity

name: Continuation functor
admissibility: preserve identities, composition, and selected limits/joins

name: Encode–recover migration channel
risk: external recovery can masquerade as autonomy

name: Staged exactification/promotion/audit bridge
signature: B = audit_T o promote o exactify o transfer
admissibility: all stage certificates and global glue pass
risk: passing local gates may not yield one package

name: Residual-bounded approximate bridge
composition: specified defect law, not assumed additivity
risk: threshold can be tuned to preferred labels
